data.name: Ussiel
data.gender_notes: Ussiel is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Ussiel is derived from the Hebrew word 'yoshea', which means 'God of salvation' or 'God of help'. In the Bible, this name is given to a priest in the tribe of Levi and a descendant of Aaron (Exodus 28:11). The name is also associated with Usiel, a legendary Hebrew hero who was a prince of Moab and a prophet of God (Numbers 21:34).
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes God's deliverance and help in times of need.
data.etymology: Ussiel belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “God of Deliverance.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ussiel total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

in_hebrew.name: אוסיאל
in_hebrew.meaning: אלוהים הוא עוזי - אלוהים עוזר לי
in_hebrew.long_meaning: אוסיאל הוא שם שפירושו 'אלוהים הוא עוזי' או 'אלוהים עוזר לי'. השם מורכב משתי מילים: 'אוס' שיכול להיות קיצור של 'עוז' שפירושו עוז או כוח, ו- 'אל' שפירושו אלוהים. השם נמצא בשימוש בקרב יהודים וגם בקרב נוצרים, והוא נושא משמעות רוחנית עמוקה של אמונה באלוהים כמקור לעוזר ולתמיכה.

in_greek.name: Ουσσιήλ
in_greek.meaning: Ο Θεός είναι η δύναμή μου
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Ουσσιήλ προέρχεται από την εβραϊκή γλώσσα και σημαίνει 'Ο Θεός είναι η δύναμή μου' ή 'Ο Θεός με βοηθά'. Η ετυμολογία του ονόματος συνδέεται με τις λέξεις 'עוז' (δύναμη) και 'אל' (Θεός). Στο πλαίσιο της χριστιανικής παράδοσης, το όνομα αυτό φέρει πνευματική σημασία, υπογραμμίζοντας την πίστη στον Θεό ως πηγή δύναμης και υποστήριξης.

in_latin.name: Ussiel
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Ussiel derivatur ex lingua hebraica et significat 'Deus est mea fortitudo' vel 'Deus mihi auxilium fert'. Etymologia nominis coniungitur cum vocibus 'עוז' (fortitudo) et 'אל' (Deus). In traditione christiana, hoc nomen profundam significationem spiritualem habet, fidem in Deum tanquam fontem fortitudinis et subsidii emphasizans.

in_english.name: Ussiel
in_english.meaning: God is my strength or God helps me
in_english.long_meaning: The name Ussiel originates from Hebrew, meaning 'God is my strength' or 'God helps me'. It is derived from two Hebrew words: 'oz' (עוז) meaning strength or help, and 'El' (אל) meaning God. In Christian tradition, Ussiel carries a spiritual significance, emphasizing faith in God as the source of strength and support. Historically, the name has been used among Jews and Christians, reflecting a profound trust in divine assistance.

data.spiritual_significance: The name Ussiel carries a deep spiritual meaning, reminding us that no matter what challenges we face, God is always present and ready to offer help and salvation. historical_references.reference: According to early Christian apocryphal literature, Ussiel was a high priest in Jerusalem during the time of Herod the Great (37-4 BC). He was known for his virtuous life and miraculous healings. The 'Testament of Ussiel' is a tractate in the 'Testaments of the Twelve Patriarchs' which recounts his life and teachings.

Ussiel is also mentioned in the 'Golden Legend' as one of the Seven Holy Founders of Monasticism. He is said to have lived in Syria during the 4th or 5th century AD and founded a monastery where he and his monks lived in extreme asceticism. According to legend, Ussiel was visited by an angel who taught him the monastic rule and instructed him to establish a monastery for the salvation of sinners.

Ussiel is also a name of religious significance in Latin American Christianity, and is often given to boys as a biblical name. In modern usage, Ussiel is seen on social media platforms such as Instagram, YouTube, and TikTok, often associated with sports and spirituality. The name has gained popularity through social media influencers and content creators who share their experiences and beliefs related to the name.
